_comment: Executive Condominium rules used by scoring/ec_rules.py. Policy, not calibration: kept out of config.py so a rule update never restamps score_version. Re-verify with HDB/MND before relying on it; update as_of when you do.

regimes.name: pre_may_2026
regimes.applies_to: EC land tenders that closed before 8 May 2026

regimes.name: may_2026
regimes.applies_to: EC land tenders that closed on or after 8 May 2026 (no Deferred Payment Scheme, 90% first-timer quota for 2 years)

notes.mop_clock: MOP runs from key collection; TOP year is used as a proxy, so a unit in its MOP or privatisation year is flagged for exact-date verification.
notes.lease_start: URA tenure 'commencing from YYYY' is the land award year (the tender), not TOP.
notes.new_ec_buyers: Buying a NEW EC needs at least one Singapore Citizen applicant, a household income within the ceiling ($16,000; $18,000 for sites tendered from 24 Aug 2026), and no private property owned or disposed of in the last 30 months. MSR 30% applies to ECs bought from the developer.
notes.resale_after_mop: Between MOP and privatisation only Singapore Citizens and PRs may buy; no income ceiling. After privatisation it is a private condo for every purpose.
